misses: What is cross-site scripting and how do I prevent it?
What does missing authentication for a critical function mean?
How does spearphishing with attachments work as an attack technique?
What is a supply chain compromise in ATT&CK?
An attacker typed ' OR 1=1 -- into our login form and got in. What class of bug is that?
Someone got our web page to run their JavaScript in other users' browsers. What weakness is that?
Our app turns user-supplied Java objects back from bytes, and someone got code execution. What weakness is this?
A user requested ../../etc/passwd from our file download endpoint and got it. What is this called?
Our server fetches any URL the user gives it, and someone used that to reach the cloud metadata endpoint. What weakness is that?
A malicious website made our logged-in users' browsers submit a money transfer form. What is this attack called?
Attackers pushed a backdoored version of a library we depend on to the package registry. Which ATT&CK technique is that?
